dedupe_keys.name: global high resolution growth projections of rooftop area consistent with the shared socioeconomic pathways 2020 2050

description: This dataset projects the gross rooftop area of buildings worldwide from 2020 to 2050 under the five Shared Socioeconomic Pathways, as a basis for estimating rooftop solar photovoltaic potential. It was published on Zenodo on 7 September 2023 by Siddharth Joshi, Behnam Zakeri, Alessio Mastrucci and Volker Krey of IIASA, Shivika Mittal of Imperial College London, Paul Holloway of University College Cork, Priyadarshi Shukla of Ahmedabad University, Brian Ó Gallachóir of MaREI and others. It has three files: a global GeoPackage of gross rooftop area in square kilometres per fishnet grid tile for 2020, 2030, 2040 and 2050 and each pathway (EPSG:4326 polygons), a country-level Parquet table attributing tiles to countries, and a Python notebook for analytics. Coverage: global. Access: about 286 MB in total on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: projections derived by machine learning from building footprints and remote sensing; usable roof area and panel yield need further assumptions. Simulation uses: rooftop PV potential in energy system scenarios and growth of building stock under climate pathways. Related records: the DLR rooftop PV suitability maps and the EU building density map.
